pages.title: Bourke
pages.description: town in New South Wales, Australia

pages.title: Howrah (district)
pages.extract: Howrah (হাওড়া Hāōṛā) is a district of West Bengal. It borders Hooghly to the north, North 24 Parganas, Kolkata and South 24 Parganas to the east, Purba Medinipur to the southwest, and Paschim Medinipur to the west.

pages.title: Islas del Rosario
pages.description: Caribbean archipelago off the coast of Colombia
pages.extract: Islas del Rosario is an archipelago located in the Caribbean Sea off the coast of Colombia.  Since 1988 the archipelago has been protected as a national park, encompassing a total area of 120,000 km2.

pages.title: Makedonski Brod
pages.description: town and seat of Makedonski Brod Municipality, North Macedonia
pages.extract: Makedonski Brod is a town in Western North Macedonia, on the south-eastern part of Suva Gora, western Karadžica, and south-western Dautica mountains. The Makedonski Brod Municipality, which consists of the town and 50 surrounding villages, contains the historical region of Poreče which is tied to the Treska River. This region has countless old villages with traditional Macedonian architecture. Aside from this, it is known for its several important caves.

pages.title: Marina di Ragusa
pages.description: human settlement in Province of Ragusa, Sicily, Italy
pages.extract: Marina di Ragusa is a city in the province of Ragusa.

pages.title: Monroe (Michigan)
pages.description: city in and county seat of Monroe County, Michigan, United States
pages.extract: Monroe is the county seat of Monroe County.

pages.title: Murchison Falls National Park
pages.extract: Murchison Falls National Park is in Northern Uganda. The park covers approximately 3840 km², and the River Nile passes through. Rabonga Forest in the southeast has large populations of chimps and the Nile has a lot of hippopotamuses and crocodiles.

pages.title: Rio Grande do Norte
pages.description: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
pages.extract: Rio Grande do Norte is a state in Northeast Brazil. It sits on the northeasternmost tip of the South American continent. Rio Grande do Norte is widely famed for its sand dunes and sunny beaches. The main attraction of Rio Grande do Norte is tourism (especially seaside), alongside fishing and local handicrafts. Since the mid-1990s, Rio Grande do Norte has had a significant increase in tourist activity, becoming one of the first destinations in northeastern Brazil because of its natural beauty and safer security than other Brazilian areas and cities.

pages.title: Samokov
pages.description: city in Samokov municipality, Sofia oblast, Bulgaria
pages.extract: Samokov (Bulgarian: Самоков, pronounced SAH-mo-kov) is a town in Central Western Bulgaria, under the slopes of the Rila mountain, 40 km (25 mi) south-east of the capital Sofia. It's the gateway to the mountain & ski resorts of Borovets and Malyovitsa nearby, and a minor tourist destination of its own.

pages.title: Southeast Sulawesi
pages.description: province of Indonesia, on island of Sulawesi

pages.title: Summer Isles
pages.description: archipelago in the mouth of Loch Broom, Highland, Scotland, UK
pages.extract: The Summer Isles are an archipelago off the coast of Ross and Cromarty in the northwest Highlands of Scotland. The largest island, Tanera Mòr, is occasionally inhabited. Since 2014 the Summer Isles have been owned by the financier Ian Wace, who intends to build a holiday resort, but to date nothing's come of this.

pages.title: Zionsville
pages.description: town in Boone County, Indiana, United States
pages.extract: Zionsville is a wealthy suburb of Indianapolis in Central Indiana, drawing visitors mainly for its quaint main street shopping area.

pages.title: Batu Karas
pages.extract: Batu Karas is a small fishing village in the East Parahyangan region on the south coast of Java, about an hour's drive from the popular seaside resort of Pangandaran.

pages.title: Pápa
pages.description: town in Veszprém county in western Hungary

pages.title: Mongu
pages.extract: Mongu is in Zambezi Basin and is the capital of the Mongu District.

pages.title: Thái Nguyên
pages.extract: Thái Nguyên is in Northern Vietnam.

pages.title: Urayasu
pages.extract: Urayasu (浦安市 Urayasu-shi) is a city in Chiba Prefecture, Japan. The city is home to Tokyo Disney Resort. Right next to Tokyo, it's a good commuter town.

pages.title: Amarah
pages.extract: Amarah is a city with about 1.2 million inhabitants in Southern Iraq and the capital of Maysan province.

pages.title: Pengzhou
pages.description: county-level city under the jurisdiction of Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China
pages.extract: Pengzhou (彭州 Péngzhōu) is a county-level city in the northwest of Sichuan Province, administered by Chengdu City. There are many beautiful mountain and forest landscapes, such as the Longmen Mountain Scenic Area.
